name: Untitled Melee RNG [KILLS OFFLINE!]
desc:
Welcome to UM-RNG!

⚔️ Roll the best weapons!
🧟 Slay hoards of zombies!
✨ Get Mana and Skill Points!
⬆️ Upgrade your Skill Tree!
🗺️ Unlock new Areas!

🎮 UPDATE 16th May:
- WEATHER EVENTS! Every 30 minutes a random weather event happens for 15 mins!
- Each weather event gives a small chance to get a MUTATED weapon with a damage multiplier!
- Snowstorm (40% chance), Sandstorm (30% Chance), Acid Rain (20% Chance) and Bloodmoon (10% Chance) events
- Frozen, Fire, Mutant and Blood Mutations added!
- Time trial rewards can also be mutated if an event happens during your run!

Remember, you get kills and mana while offline! ⌚

Made with ❤️ by Team Crystal
